report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: order logs show 200/ok, error_rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. The deployment record only proves version 3.0.4 replaced 3.0.3 and cannot establish deployment-caused failure. No checkout failure evidence exists, so no bounded candidate is supported; hand off for missing evidence.
missing_evidence: Checkout failure evidence: error logs, failed request traces, or error-rate spike for the checkout path
Confirmation of which service actually serves checkout and whether order is on that path
Deployment timing relative to failure onset (change age ~2588 min vs incident window)
Any alert-aligned service facts or failing dependency signals (payment, inventory, postgresql)
